about: List prices in US dollars per million tokens of the models CURIO_EVAL_MODELS names that are billed by the token. The skill-evals report prices each run's tokens with them, the grader's among them (scripts/skill_evals_report.py). A model not listed here is not priced. claude-haiku-5-5: Anthropic's list prices for prompts up to 100K tokens, as of 2026-10-06; past 100K tokens they are 0.50 and 2.50.
